_source: eclipse-player.md §12.1 (REQ-UIX-001). Values are canonical: both platforms consume THIS file — Android via a build-time code generator, desktop via a .qrc-embedded resource — rather than duplicating the numbers. A duplicated number is a number that will drift.

typography._basis: 14 px base, 1.2 ratio. Sizes in px, lineHeight as a multiplier, letterSpacing in px.

elevation._basis: Five ascending levels as offsetY / blur / alpha. Shadow colour comes from the active theme, never from here — a fixed shadow colour looks wrong in one of the two modes.

motion._basis: REQ-UIX-002: animation explains a change of state and never decorates. Every animation must be interruptible and must honour reduced-motion (REQ-UIX-060) — under reduced-motion every duration below collapses to 0 rather than being merely shortened.

normal.use: Panel and view transitions, skin cross-fade

emphasized._note: Shares the `standard` curve; what makes it emphasized is that §12.1 pairs it with the `slow` duration. Encoded as a pairing rather than a fifth curve so the table and this file say the same thing.
